subject: Parkwell: Proposed availability annex + order form language for enterprise MSA
messages:
From: Lisa Gomez <lgomez@parkwellhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mrivera@parkwellhealth.com>, procurement@parkwellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Availability exhibit for Parkwell enterprise MSA - initial ask

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Parkwell's engineering and infra teams were impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to follow up with the specific availability/latency language we need in a formal exhibit and how that maps to your order form. Two items we'd like you to confirm:

- Can Redwood commit to a 99.95% monthly availability for our paid Dedicated pool (region: us-west-2)?
- We need a clear latency SLO for 95th/99th token latency for typical chat workloads (256-token context) and a proposal for credits if SLOs are missed.

We're starting MSA review with legal next week and would appreciate a draft exhibit or suggested order form wording we can attach to the SOW. Also please include any evidence/attestation we can share with compliance (SOC 2 scope, retention of audit logs).

Do you have a first-pass exhibit you can send? If helpful, Mark can coordinate with our procurement intake template.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager
Parkwell Health
Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lgomez@parkwellhealth.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mrivera@parkwellhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability exhibit for Parkwell enterprise MSA - initial ask

Lisa — great to hear the demo landed well. I'm attaching a first-pass availability exhibit and a short order-form snippet that maps availability tiers to credits. Quick answers up front:

- We can target 99.95% monthly availability for a dedicated pool in us-west-2 as a custom order (requires agreed burst policy and capacity commit).
- We'll propose 95th/99th token latency targets for 256-token chat. Draft includes a credit curve tied to monthly availability and an explicit MTTR (mean time to restore) SLA for service-impacting events.

Could you confirm: estimated concurrent sessions and expected QPS during peak? Also let me know if Parkwell requires data residency beyond us-west-2 (e.g., private VPC-only access).

I've attached: parkwell_availability_exhibit_draft_v1.docx and parkwell_orderform_proposed_snippet.txt. 

I'll loop in internal follow-ups with legal and solutions so we can finalize language for your legal team.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: parkwell_availability_exhibit_draft_v1.docx, parkwell_orderform_proposed_snippet.txt
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Parkwell availability exhibit - need quick review and negotiation plan

Team — forwarding Parkwell's ask and the draft exhibit (attached). Need quick input on:

1) Order-form credit formula: the draft ties credits to monthly availability bands (>=99.95%, 99.9-99.95%, <99.9%). Is that acceptable commercially or do we want a hybrid (credit + service fee rebate) approach?
2) Latency SLOs: they requested 95th/99th token latencies for 256-token chats. Do we expose 99th token latency in order form or keep as operational target?
3) MTTR definition and exclusions (maintenance, customer misconfig). Laura — can you flag any legal landmines in the exhibit redlines?

Attachments: Parkwell_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf (please annotate).

Thanks — I need to respond to Parkwell by Monday EOD.

— Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Parkwell availability exhibit - need quick review and negotiation plan

Quick notes from GTM/AM perspective:

- Optics: Parkwell is large and will push for straightforward credits. Keep the bands but simplify math — two bands: >=99.95% (no credit) and <99.95% (credit cap). We can offer a capped credit of up to 50% pro rata of monthly fee for severe outages.
- Latency SLO: propose to include the 95th percentile in the order form as a guaranteed SLO (e.g., 95th p95 token latency <= 120ms for 256-token chat). Keep the 99th as a measurement/operational metric in the exhibit but not for credits — that protects us from burst anomalies.
- MTTR: propose 4 hours for Priority 1 incidents (service down for whole pool), with exclusions for force majeure and scheduled maintenance given 48-hour prior notice.
- Evidence: be ready to provide SOC 2 Type II summary report and a sanitized uptime report for the last 6 months (redact customer identifiers).

Suggested order-form snippet (high level):
"If Monthly Availability < 99.95%, Customer will be eligible for Service Credits up to 50% of the Monthly Service Fee, calculated pro rata for the period of unavailability, subject to the exclusions below."

Happy to take the first pass with legal on wording. I think commercial can accept this.

— Ben
From: Lisa Gomez <lgomez@parkwellhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mrivera@parkwellhealth.com>, procurement@parkwellhealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Parkwell: Proposed availability annex + order form language for enterprise MSA

Soojin — thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from Parkwell legal/procurement after reviewing your draft:

- 99.95% target is acceptable if backed by a clear definition of "Monthly Availability" and the method of calculating downtime. Please include the measurement window and time-synchronization assumptions.
- We need a concrete MTTR commitment for P1 incidents and a single point-of-contact escalation path (name/role/email) for production-impacting events. 4 hours is reasonable; can you confirm escalation contact?
- Data residency: Parkwell requires that production data for our tenant remain in us-west-2 and that all inference compute for our Dedicated pool is pinned to that region. Is that covered under the Dedicated order?
- SOC 2: provide the Type II report and confirmation that audit logs for customer activity are retained for 12 months.

If you can send a redlined exhibit that reflects the measurement definition, explicit region pinning, the MTTR and escalation contact, and the SOC 2 evidence link, we can get it to our legal team to attach to the MSA.

Regards,
Lisa
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Gomez <lgomez@parkwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Parkwell: Proposed availability annex + order form language for enterprise MSA

Lisa — thank you, and appreciate the specificity. Summary of agreed updates and next steps:

1) Measurement: updated exhibit defines "Monthly Availability" as (Total minutes in month - Unavailable minutes) / Total minutes, with downtime recorded using UTC timestamps from our monitoring system; we will provide the measurement report in csv on request.
2) Credits: order-form language simplified to single band (>=99.95% -> no credit; <99.95% -> credits up to 50% pro rata). Wording in parkwell_orderform_proposed_snippet.txt attached.
3) Latency SLO: include 95th percentile token latency (256-token chat) as a customer-facing SLO at <= 120ms; 99th percentile will be recorded and shared as operational telemetry (not credit-triggering).
4) MTTR & Escalation: MTTR for P1 incidents set to 4 hours. Primary escalation contact: Ben Carter, Head of Sales Ops, ben_carter@redwood.com; secondary: Karthik Iyer, Solutions Lead, karthik_iyer@redwood.com.
4) Region & Residency: Dedicated pool can be pinned to us-west-2; we will document the region pinning in the order form and in the exhibit.
5) Compliance evidence: we'll share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a 12-month audit log retention confirmation via our secure drive link.

I've attached a revised exhibit (parkwell_availability_exhibit_draft_v1.docx — now annotated) and the order-form snippet. For execution, I can prepare a redlined exhibit for you and a DocuSign packet once legal gives the green light. Link to preliminary DocuSign packet: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/abcd-parkwell-exhibit.

Please confirm if Parkwell legal wants any further changes; otherwise we'll mark this as the agreed exhibit language to append to the MSA and send the DocuSign packet.

Thanks — Soojin
Attachments: parkwell_availability_exhibit_draft_v1.docx, parkwell_orderform_proposed_snippet.txt
